People Ops: @here quick heads-up — this Saturday (Apr 10) we’re running a coordinated deep-clean + HVAC safety test across SF and PDX hubs. Please read: 
- When: Sat Apr 10, 08:00–13:00 local hub times
- Impact: intermittent loud testing noise ~09:00–11:30, some floors temporarily closed for access/inspection
- Access: keycards remain active but security will man turnstiles; expect brief checks on entry
- Desks: hot desks and some assigned desks will be flagged as MAINT during the window; reservations will be auto-cancelled and refunded
- Parking: garage closed 07:30–14:00; short-term parking exceptions only for approved onsite-only work (see reimbursement form)
If you can avoid coming onsite during the window, please do. If you must be onsite for an essential rollout or on-call work, reply with your name + floor and we’ll arrange an escort or a quieter room. :wrench: :broom:

Marco: Quick Q — will pod rooms 3A/3B be affected? We have a recording planned.

People Ops: 3A will be closed for HVAC access. 3B will remain open but expect intermittent noise. If you have recordings or meetings, please reschedule or claim a quiet room (see below).

Sara: @People Ops — will this affect badge revalidation / late-night access? I’ve got a deploy Saturday night.

Katie: Night badge holders should still be able to enter; we’ve scheduled badge revalidation tests for 14:00 to avoid conflict. Security will perform quick checks. If you need guaranteed uninterrupted access after 20:00, DM me and we’ll log you on the exemption list.

Alex: We have a canary that needs low-noise conditions. Is there a ‘quiet lane’ option or an isolated room we can use?

People Ops: Yes — we’ll open a private room on 4th floor with headset and monitoring setup. Reply here to claim it (max 4 teams). First come, first served.

Jamal: The parking reimbursement link in the announcement 404’d for me earlier — can someone resend?

People Ops: Sorry about that — fixed link: https://redwood.internal/forms/parking-reim-2026 
(Use this to request reimbursement or a short-term exception; approvals same day for essential on-site work.)

Facilities Bot: Scheduled maintenance created: "Global Weekend Deep Clean & HVAC Safety Testing" — Apr 10 08:00–13:00. Rooms impacted: 3A, 5 (east wing).

DeskReserve Bot: All desks impacted during the window have been flagged MAINT-0426. Reservations in that window are automatically cancelled and refunded to the original reservation owner.

Sara: :thumbsup: Thanks — will reschedule the deploy to avoid the window.

Marco: I’ll cancel our recording and book the 4th-floor quiet room.

People Ops: Thanks all. We’ll post a short floor map with closed zones + the quiet-room booking link by EOD Friday. If you’re traveling in and need help with logistics, ping @Katie directly and include your arrival time and floor.
